Akihito is a diligent local masseur who is loved by his regular elderly customers. He has but a simple dream, to find a person of his type: A black-haired beauty. When his co-workers learn about it, they tease him, telling him to have realistic standards on finding a girlfriend. But the thing is, Akihito's co-workers don't have an idea that Akihito isn't looking for the ideal girl but the ideal man. In short, he's gay. Enter Kei Himemiya, the new trainee. The first time Akihito laid his eyes on Kei, Kei totally has everything Akihito is looking for in an ideal partner that it's almost a miracle. And when the two got closer and slept together, Akihito is over the moon for Kei. Is this the start of a blossoming love life for Akihito, or is Kei not that ideal as he seems?

On a rainy night, Akira Akamori, a high school student about to transfer to a new school, saw his blonde classmate, Aoi Sotome, standing in the park drenched from the rain. “…I don’t have a home anymore.” Though Aoi was a complete stranger to him, Akira couldn’t leave a girl alone, so he took her home. “Thanks for the hot bath.” “I-It’s fine…” When Akira heard about Aoi’s complicated situation, he decided to help her and let her live with him until he transferred to a new school. While confused by their new cohabitation arrangement, the two slowly grew close to each other. It is a love story of two people who repeatedly come together and drift apart.

(Source: GA Bunko, translated)

A unique coming-of-age love comedy between a "self-proclaimed vampire-hunting gal" and a "high school boy who lives in the shadows"!

137025.description:
Tatsuo and Satoru are a student and a teacher who are also in a secret relationship. Satoru is a straight-laced literature teacher who is determined not to touch Tatsuo until after he graduates. Unfortunately, Tatsuo is all too interested in physical pleasure, and tries new ways to seduce the older man every day. One day, Satoru's beloved cat, Natsume, suddenly starts to talk! Tatsuo wants her help to take his relationship to the next level, so he reveres Natsume as his professor, and asks her to teach him how to seduce her owner...!

Princess, hero, priestess, witch, and maid.
If you had to choose one to be your queen, who would it be?

The war between humans and demons had just ended, but the world still feared more conflict. The only way to assure peace is for the Demon Lord (female) to take a human queen!

Which heroine will you choose? Your choice will help guide the story to its conclusion! It's a new kind of reader-participation harem comedy!

In a world coming to its end, who do you want to be loved by? As the end of the world ticks by, this is a story of two girl's trembling love, and their terrifying memories. (This is a comedy)

Two years after the death of the idol Sora Tajima, who was the center of the idol group Polaris, people are gradually forgetting about her. High school girl Mizuumi Tachibana can't accept this, and attempts the impossible in order to prove the existence of a "God". In a world where likes are everything, she will create the eternal idol.

137030.description:
After parting from her husband, Yoshiko leaves their mansion and starts living alone in an apartment. A man falls in love with her, and chases her. She ignores the man, and walks in the city. During the walk they encounter Yakuza...

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

137031.description:
Jean Pildu, a serial killer who killed as many as 25 people, was arrested by police as a wanted criminal and sentenced to death in court. However, the day before the execution day, he slipped on a banana peel and suffered a concussion, losing all his memory. Execution of the sentence is suspended since it is not possible to punish a person who has no memory of their misdeeds. Experts from various fields are mobilized to retrieve the memory of Jean Pildu.

(Source: natalie.mu, translated)

137032.description:
When Da-Eun wakes up, she finds herself in a dating simulation game as Diana, a pretty schoolgirl surrounded by beautiful people with floating hearts above their heads. To her surprise, there seem to be no rules beyond the ability to conquer anyone, regardless of their gender, age, or even species -- yes, even dogs have heart-o-meters! Dating is fun, sure, but Diana has something else in mind… the ultimate goal of the dating sim genre -- to form a harem. She starts to strategize, but will things pan out as she plans?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

137033.description:
A sparrow named O-chun crashed into the studio of a struggling young painter. To thank him for healing her injuries, O-chun will cheerfully return the favor any way she can! A relationship between human and bird that transcends biological boundaries in a cute modern fairy tale!

(Source: Comic Action, translated)

Note: Originally published as shorts on the author's Twitter before being picked up for serialization.

137034.description:
"Please stay by my side."
After getting involved in a scandal, Kihae is forced to give up his acting career. Then he starts hearing voices whenever he encounters strangers. Therapy, music, avoiding people — he's tried it all, but nothing seems to help. That is, until he meets Mujin.

(Source: Manta)

137036.description:
Rumor has it that the emperor and the prime minister are at odds with each other, and some people say that the prime minister got his position because he looks like the emperor's former lover. But is that the truth? One is a mean and seemingly aloof emperor, and the other is a weak prime minister who is excluded by others. One is chasing, and the other is escaping, but the social stigma stops them from moving forward. Can they relive the good old days of the past?

(Source: Webcomics)

137038.description: Hayashi has to take remedial lessons during summer vacation, but that gives her the chance to spend time alone with her crush, Nagi-kun. How will she take advantage of this opportunity?

137042.description:
Every family has its own "secrets"... Meet our protagonist, Shota Minamoto, a junior-high school student who also happens to be an orphan in a children's home. One day, he was adopted by a family living in a luxurious, Japanese-style estate. Welcomed warmly by them all, Shota started letting his guard down but this family had a "secret" that the world could never know.

A new work from the creator of "The Cuckoo's Fiance" showcasing a different kind of "family." Thus begins a cozy, bloody love comedy!

He accidentally met Fan Jing, a new star who is well known for playing "hard to get". In order to make the the proud and stubborn beauty fall completely in love with him, Ye Yu Xiao made a bet with his friends that Fan Jing would fall in love with him within 3 months. However, 3 months later...the scenario of chasing the wife changed! Who will be the first to fall into the trap of this love match?

(Source: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)

B-Magic is the hottest beauty vlogger in the beauty industry. Everyone is always waiting for her next upload! Little do they know that B-Magic is trying to live a normal life as a high school boy? What secrets is she hiding? And will her classmates uncover her identity?

"Tingting, I know. Ever since the first time I watched Whalespeak, I knew that you weren't acting as Xia. I knew that you are Xia himself."

To fill the loneliness of being neglected by her unfaithful boyfriend, Sou-kun, Haru begins working in the sex industry. As she gets paid a not insignificant amount of money, and as she puts her body on top of many customers as if to confirm her own worth, her feelings gradually change...? Marune makes grilled miso to calm her mind, but she is unexpectedly reunited with Nobunaga Oda. But he has a very beautiful girlfriend... Will the recipes of the Warring States period save love?

137062.description:
Often cited as the origin of the heta-uma (or 'bad but good' ) style of manga art, Penguin Gohan is a classic Garo gag manga featuring the crude, lewd, and gory exploits of a penguin and his family. It is a wild anthology of 20 surreal stories characterized by a grotesque humor bordering on ero-guro and nonsense.

In Penguin Gohan, the literary genius of the eclectic Shigesato Itoi combines with the singular art of Teruhiko Yumura, one of the greatest masters of Japanese underground illustration.

The series has been published three times since its original run in Garo, and each edition has been slightly different: first by JOHO Center Publishing in 1980 (Jounetsu no Penguin Gohan), by Chikuma Bunko in 1993 (Kanpon Jounetsu no Penguin Gohan), and by Hobonichi Books in 2011 (Sayonara Penguin).

Wait, why am I wanted by the world after I sign the marriage contract?? To survive, I have to take the princess for a leap of faith:

Nakano offers to help him drown his sorrows in raw, rough sex but also drops a bomb the next day... "Tsuji, I've been in love with you for a long time."

(Source: Manga.Club)

137183.description:
An endless struggle among monsters is about to begin.

Kumori sees a vampire attack on his way to school and thinks he’s done for, but that vampire saves him from another vampire! Mortally wounded, Kumori has a choice: To die or to become a STEEL VAMPIRE!

(Source: Mangamo)

137184.description: Shishi Sakurazaka, a soccer player in his third year of middle school. He has speed that puts dedicated track runners to shame, but has no talent for shooting a goal, which has led to him being an eternal benchwarmer. But one day, while playing an online soccer game, he meets a genius gamer.

137185.description: Mamori Kurisaka is a college student who has recently started living alone in Tokyo after entering university. She secretly admires the handsome designer, Yoji Asagata, who lives in the room next door. After Mamori finds some unsettling documents in her mailbox, the two became closer and she found herself seeking haven in his mini-vegetable garden on the veranda!

137186.description:
Masumi sneaks into her family's rival company as a spy to steal their secrets.
While she thinks she is being hired to be the CEO's personal assistant, she ends up being assigned to the chief manager, Kouki Hasumi, who was supposedly bad news back in high school.
A quirk of fate leads them to a hotel together where she carelessly pushes him onto the bed and kisses him!
Contrary to his scary, tough-guy persona, his reaction is innocent and so cute...
How's he supposed to control himself when the woman he's in love with kisses him!?
What should Masumi do!? She didn't mean to, but it looks like she's provoked the beast inside him!
A love affair at the office.

(Source: Renta!)

137187.description: At the order of his black-hearted boss, corporate slave, Niwa, works overtime every day without a day off. His heart is without rest these days without a cute girlfriend... However, after passing out drunk, he wakes up in the embrace of his easygoing kouhai, Nagase?! Niwa tries to keep his distance from Nagase, but his body has already been exploited by him.

137189.description:
Manabe Shiro has a stressful job managing a travel agency, and when the workday is done he blows off steam by working as a “maid” at a cross-dressing café. The café is Shiro’s safe place, until one night his sardonic subordinate Nabatame Kuro comes in! Though the two might not get along at work, now that Kuro knows his secret, Shiro is willing to do whatever it takes to make sure Kuro keeps his mouth shut. Can this fraught relationship become something fulfilling for both men?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Shouji's new boss is a merciless beast. He might be great for the bottom line, but he's definitely done a number on Shouji's work-life balance - and his love life! One fateful weekend, Shouji sees his fearsome boss, Mr. Gokudera, in the flesh, coming out of a women's lingerie store. Recently heartbroken, Shouji thinks it's unfair that his boss gets to have a girlfriend - but is all that lingerie really for someone else?

(Source: Futekiya)

Claire Martino once had everything: a loving family, a crown prince fiancé, and a hopeful future using her family's inherited magic. Then, in an instant, she lost it all — and the culprit was her own beloved half-sister. As the daughter of the now-disgraced duke and scorned as a villainess, Claire leaves everything she knows and sets out on a journey to find her true self.

But wait, isn't that the plot of the otome game NEW START ♡ ETERNAL LOVE on its hardest route...?

“I love Kotoha and Kazuya so much! Everyone who appears is just adorable... I want to visit Café Mikami myself! And I want to keep watching Kotoha and Kazuya’s romance slowly and gently blossom over time... Ahhh, they’re just too cute!”

After quitting her restaurant job in outrage over workplace harassment, 26-year-old chef Kotoha Mikami decides it’s time for a fresh start. She renovates her late grandmother’s beloved shop and sets out to open her very own café. Coming to her rescue is her brother’s friend, 28-year-old Kazuya Hirosawa—a mild-mannered, glasses-wearing guy who doesn’t exactly scream “reliable.” But when the café’s grand opening is suddenly in jeopardy, he steps up and saves the day. Caught off guard by this unexpected side of him, Kotoha soon finds she can’t stop noticing him...

137197.description:
When my mom announced her remarriage, I knew I would be getting a stepbrother. But to my surprise, it was my idol, the super famous model Noa!

He has made a name for himself with his cold attitude, but for some reason, he is extremely nice to me! The number one model waking me up in the mornings, helping me with my homework... and even giving me the occasional hug?!

(Source: MangaUP! Global)

I joined a part-time job at a cafe because there was a girl in a cute maid outfit.

137200.description:
Ever heard of an “alpha mate” before? It’s someone who’s paid to be an alpha’s sexual plaything during their rut. Or a person who’s used by a non-alpha who wants to present as an alpha. Which is why Se-Jun is not at all pleased when his childhood crush, Yeon-Woo, is brought in as his alpha mate in the hopes of turning Se-Jun into a true alpha. Here’s a secret: Se-Jun is already an alpha. With a contract between them and a secret that Se-Jun is determined to keep, will these two be able to make a true connection?

(Source: Lezhin US)

137201.description:
Arthur Groban, a new detective with the LAPD, is desperate to prove his ability despite being a rookie within the force. But with every case he is assigned, things look more and more bleak as the corruption in the shadows becomes ever more apparent. Feeling helpless, Arthur is almost ready to give up when he happens to cross paths with the mysterious and alluring Silas Moore. Silas is willing to pull some strings behind the scenes to help Arthur, so long as the detective gives him two things in exchange: his body, and his pride. The further Arthur goes for Silas, the more he will get in return. But how far is too far in the pursuit of justice?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Include 11 extra chapters.

137202.description:
Miya is the illegitimate child of a prominent family. When her mother dies and her father’s estate agrees to take her in, she’s convinced she knows what awaits her in her new home: a life of servitude and misery at the hands of her wicked stepmother and stepsisters. Yet when she finally meets the women she expects to treat her like dirt, they actually end up being…sweet?! A hilarious and heartfelt comedy that’s sure to put a smile on your face!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

It's a youthful comedy about three girls stuck repeating high school!

After being a recluse for a year, Koto will be a high school freshman for the second time in the spring.
She is lazy in the morning, forgetful, not good at studying, and not good at interpersonal relationships.

She is a fragile and wounded creature, full of weaknesses. But with the help of her new friends who are also repeating their first year, she tries to start a normal school life.

The girl who realized that no one would help her, picked up the blade with a quiet murderous gleam in her eyes.

The main character, Rui, is getting bullied at school. Mr. Himuro However, however, tells Rui that there is no bullying after talking to her classmates. Since no one would help her, Rui decided to take matters in her own hands. She begins planning a murder and staging it as a suicide or accident, but she is unaware that there is more evil than her bullies and father-in-law...

137228.description:
On a fateful rainy day, Arata Shinooka falls head over heels in love upon venturing into a quiet little tearoom. The one he falls for, Chihiro Kiritani, is a cheerful waiter like none other with a cute smile. Paying no heed to the tearoom's closing hours, Arata is invited to take shelter from the rain and is immediately taken in by both Chihiro's kindness and the tearoom's friendly atmosphere - so much so that he decides to work there part-time! After being there three months, Arata attempts to close the gap between him and Chihiro, but each time he approaches him, he's virtually paralyzed by his cuteness!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Chapter count includes one extra.

137229.description:
One was an influential boss in entertainment business, and the other was a young innocent idol. As each other's rival in love, they never got along, but were forced to be a popular "super couple" because of a "special deal". The false gradually became the truth—love started to grow between them. However, conspiracies and danger also tailed after...

(Source: WebComics)

Note: Chapter count includes 16 extra chapters.

137230.description:
In the Catanish Empire, wives are bought and sold like property at auctions. Chloe, once married to an abusive husband, is bought by a mysterious man, who turns out to be one of the most powerful men in the empire. Marquess Ash Brinacle marries Chloe and is determined to give her the life she deserves and to mend her heart of her past. Chloe is overwhelmed at first by his kindness, something she's never felt in her life for a long time. Can she overcome her scars and open up her heart to him?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

137231.description:
He’s in his late twenties with a clean record, but no savings, no girlfriend, and no sense of actually being alive. As a bottom-tier security guard standing before a pool of blood, he wonders: will the habits stained into the souls of the poor attract money, or death?

While rushing to a luxury mansion for work, he stumbles upon "dirty money" and a thief attempting to take it. The protagonist, who absolutely should have apprehended the intruder, dares to let him escape. But when he checks into a hospital as a precaution, the person waiting for him there is none other than the owner of that cash.

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

Sojin Yeon, a temporary employee who posts her daily work life on her vlog, gets caught in the midst of a messy crime scene after the murder of her assistant manager. Her viewer ratings are escalating along with the shadows of her past latching onto her from moving forward. Can she break free from the mysterious crimes that are continuously occurring around her?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

137236.description:
The story between a crazy wolf-like general and a powerful femme-fatale in an omegaverse (ABO) parallel world. She's a cool and domineering person who transmigrates to different worlds to teach scumbags a lesson.

137237.description:
Several centuries ago, the Saber Lord defeated the Sword Emperor, causing countless sword cultivators to lose their status. They were bullied and ridiculed, until... the birth of a certain young man, one destined to bring about change! Chu Mu was originally the adopted son of the Chu Family. Yet, after he sacrificed his saber soul to perfect his sword soul, he fell from his glorious throne. They laughed at him, betrayed him, and even his fiancee chose to leave him... But what's wrong with having a "useless" sword soul? With a determined heart, Chu Mu will do the sword soul justice, and become the most powerful being in the universe!

(Source: WebComics)

137238.description:
It is said that in this world, there is a race that can control the minds of ordinary people. They use the poison in their bodies to control others, like a bee with its poisonous stinger. That's why they are called "BEE". One day, Mitsuba is suddenly turned into a BEE, and together with Sosuke Hibari, a lecturer at the university who specializes in BEE research, they will try to create a drug that will turn her back into a human. However, in order to do so, Mitsuba must go into heat and expose herself in front of Sosuke...?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

137239.description:
"Let's have a quickie. Don't you wanna do it... with me?"

Lin is a cute and innocent-looking pop star whose popularity explodes the moment she debuts. She's also an aggressive predator when it comes to men! Right before her show, she's hooking up with the cute intern boy and her pop-star-crazed manager. Lately, she can only get off with a certain someone, though... Even off the stage, her skirt is soaking wet!? It's an intense pop star story with an extra helping of heated action!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

137240.description:
Kohei is a high school student whose passion is photography. Bright, cheerful, and full of curiosity, Kohei declares his love for the school doctor, Kenichiro Tachibana, after meeting him in what's called the Locked Infirmary. He isn't shy about his feelings, but Kenichiro seems to have a past... With the earnest affection of a puppy, Kohei pushes on. How will he win the love of the sulky and impregnable older man who's full of mature appeal in this love comedy between opposites who are linked by photography!?

(Source: Renta!)

137243.description:
Lupin III Gaiden is a one-shot side story of Lupin III released in the March 26, 1970 issue of Manga Action, published by Futabasha.

This chapter was written to celebrate the 1970 World's Fair in Osaka, Japan, and was later included in the Lupin III Collection of Unpublished Works.

137244.description:
One night when it was raining cats and dogs, Seung-Jo, who was looking for a place to shelter from the rain, ended up at a well-known wealthy house in Gyeongseong. Hui-Un, tthe young master of the place and he was surrounded by ghosts and monsters. Seung-Jo has the ability to get rid of them and while helping each other they start getting closer...

(Source: Mr. Blue, translated)

137245.description:
A strange character, half philosopher, half charlatan, arrives at a small mountain inn run by a lonely woman who also looks after her younger sister Karen and her younger brother Heikichi. He leads them into a wonderful world, searching for fox eggs among the pebbles in the river and talking with angels.

(Source: Éditions Picquier, translated)

137246.description:
Sha En is a cute boy who secretly likes to wear girls' clothing when no one is looking. His secret is discovered by Xia Zuo, a loner who likes to make lolita dresses. A light-hearted romance between two boys who share the same love for cute dresses.

Mr. Yamano is a gym teacher at a small elementary school in the countryside. When gorgeous math teacher Mr. Kiyono transfers in from Tokyo, Mr. Yamano is lovestruck. One day, the two have to stay the night in a school office, and Mr. Yamano is so excited at the chance to get with his crush! Too bad his mood isn't the only thing that perks up, revealing his secret to Mr. Kiyono! But, turns out the seemingly chaste Mr. Kiyono is all too happy to ride Mr. Yamano's seven inches of man meat!!

Karen and Mitsunaga are now 20 years old. Mitsunaga used to say that marriage is too early at 20, but he is beginning to think that maybe it wouldn't be so bad. One day, while they were out on a lovely day like usual, Karen has an accident!

(Source: NINO, translated)

137252.description:
Lance, who had been abroad for many years, suddenly returned home and broke Laine's peaceful life. This abstinent guy was pretty much a stumbling block in Laine's life, who pissed Laine off every day and always "bullied" him for fun. However, a company crisis completely changed Laine's view of Lance. At the same time, Laine also perceived the true purpose and ambition of Lance's return... What's Laine supposed to do?

(Source: WebComics)

137253.description:
“Shall we get married?” — A fake marriage between two men?!

Yuuki Ritsu, a cool-headed and serious office worker, was suddenly proposed to by his colleague and rival Honjou Haruma, due to some special circumstances. With same-sex marriage becoming possible in Japan, the people around the single, 29-year old Ritsu had been constantly nagging at him to get married soon.

On the other hand, Haruma had found himself in a bind due to his uncontrollable popularity. With Haruma’s suggestion of a marriage that would benefit both parties, Ritsu decided to accept his proposal in order to escape from the corner he was driven into. Little did he know that married life with Haruma, who loves taking care of others, would be so comfortable… Plus, he gives massages that are out of this world…!

Although it started with a lie, a sweet and delicious marriage love between the two single, handsome office workers in their thirties starts to bloom!

(Source: Overlap, translated)

137255.description:
Acting like he's a man of the people, Ryo Aihara's a CEO of his own successful production company. He hasn't been seriously involved with anyone in quite some time, though, and is feeling lonely as a result.

One night after dinner with a client, he's drunk and crouched down in an alley when a man in sunglasses approaches him. Behaving as if he were trying to pick up a woman, the man talks to Ryo as if he knows him.
A pissed off Ryo decides to mess around with the man a little and kisses him to shut him up. Ryo calls him out for not only having his hair cut to look like a certain actor, but for looking bad in it.
The next morning, he wakes up at home and turns on the TV to see the actor Riku Amamiya, the man with the sunglasses from last night...!

One day, Ryo's so excited about seeing Riku for the first time in a while that he makes a mistake at work. He knows Riku is trying to catch up to him professionally and now can't face him. Riku's manager takes advantage of Ryo's momentary dejection to try and end Riku and Ryo's relationship.
They yearn for one another, but can't see each other. Neither wants to show the other anything but their suave side. After all the conflict, will the love they share ever be as straightforward as they deserve...?

Ayumu Amano's childhood friend, Shinta Yamada, is as plain as a guy can be. They're both in the same college, attending the same classes, and Ayumu worries about his clingy friend. One day, the class playboy Hibi, asks to talk to him. Ayumu hopes to get some advice, but it turns out Hibi's swings both ways and has a crush on Shinta! Hinoura struggles to concentrate and feels sleepy all the time, but for no particular reason… or so he thought. When Hinoura finds out that he’s… not like the others… maybe he should stay away from Mr. Tsukigase… if he can, that is.

Human prayed, Gods were born. This is how "Yaoi" God came to us. The Moon God believes in marriage between men and women, but Yaoi God says that gender can not determine loves. What will happen after the collision between the new mind of Yaoi and the conservative mind of Moon?

Kang Jin-Hyeok, a gaming streamer, and content creator is the only person who has cleared the game, [Tower of Trials]. However, as the game’s popularity declines, it becomes increasingly difficult for him to continue making a living as a content creator. Jinhyeok prepares to end his 11-year-long relationship with the game and say goodbye to his humble group of subscribers. But on that very day, the Tower of Trials appears in reality with a message saying that humanity will perish unless all players clear each floor within 90 days. Jin-Hyeok, who knows the game better than anyone, decides to use his knowledge to his advantage and dominate the tower. It’s time to show everyone what a hardcore gamer can do!

In a world where ninjas are still active behind the scenes, the heirs of the Kouga and Iga ninja clans attend the same high school as regular students. 137283.description:
Naoki, an office worker who's dead tired from overtime hell, suddenly got transported to a day-care nursery in another world.☆

Meeting him is an elf with a soothing personality named Fomani, and she begins to pamper him!
Fomani is puzzled upon hearing Naoki's age, saying "30 years old!? Why, that's only around the age where kids stop wearing diapers!" and she offers to give him a massage♪

137286.description:
Have you ever wondered if the person you like is dreaming about you? Teacher Yeoreum Han doesn’t have to guess -- she can make it happen, with her ability to walk into other people’s dreams. She can even link the dreams of two people together, and use this ability to play Cupid for her students. But her matchmaking goes awry when she enters the dream of Si-u Park -- a lucid dreamer, who realizes that Yeoreum is walking into his dream. Si-u and Yeoreum’s lives become intertwined after this incident, weaving a tangled web of love, friendship, and dreamers at Hanseo High.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

137288.description:
In order to stay by the side of his liege, Arsmeria, the devoted knight Vance chose to reincarnate with her a thousand years into the future. In his new life he’s known as Lloyd, the foster son of Countess Myuria and the wielder of colorless magic. But Lloyd has kept his memories of his past life and of his quest, and when he finds that Arsmeria’s reincarnated soul has been divided into six parts and spread amongst many, he realizes he’s got his work cut out for him!

The Mad Demon, Ja-Ha Lee, dreams of becoming the God of Martial Arts. Unfortunately, his dreams are dashed after he falls off a cliff while running from the Demonic Cult for stealing the Jade of Heaven. Yet this is not the end for Ja-Ha -- he awakens from the fall to find himself back in his 20s. With his knowledge of the future and of martial arts, he now has a chance at revenge and at getting life right this time. Will he be able to fulfill his dream this time around, or is he doomed to face the same fate yet again?

Six years since she was transported to another world, Chika served as a pet slave for the strong and handsome knight Douglas. Normally, a pet slave would also serve her master in bed, but for some reason Douglas was not able to perform, so Chika still retained her virginity. It turned out that Douglas was traumatized as a prisoner of war by Chika while she was a prison guard disguised as a boy. As they spent time together, Chika's heart was touched by how Douglas treated her with wholesome kindness. Everyone could see that they were in love with each other, but will they be able to overcome their fears and misunderstandings and come to a happy ending?

137327.description:
A self-proclaimed unattractive gloomy high schooler, Hiramiya Reiji, gets messed around by his friend's older sister, Sakuya, every time he goes to visit him at home. Drinking his drink as she pleases, barging into the bathroom, and crawling under his blanket in the middle of the night… Thinking that perhaps he has done something to make her dislike him, he asked his close friend whether he has any idea, but he only gets a reply in an incomprehensible way, “you still haven't noticed it, huh”.

On a certain day, Reiji loses in a game and has to listen to 3 of Sakuya’s wishes. Reiji goes along with it even though he has doubts, but could he gradually begin to understand Sakuya’s true feelings…?

This is the story of super dense youth and a can’t-be-honest older sister until they become a lovey-dovey married couple.

137331.description: The story follows the Kirihara brothers who from a young age were incarcerated in a secure scientific facility due to their supernatural powers, having escaped after the barrier that was preventing them malfunctions. The story also follows the Kuroki brothers who are trying to chase the Kirihara brothers.

137334.description:
In the end, we’re all the same…we just want to be smothered like babies against another human’s beating heart.

Through a cracked door, heartsick Emi hears a playful growl. Cautiously, she lets her lover in—a wolf of a man wielding a bouquet of roses. His shoulders must have been four inches wider than mine. As I stood behind him, I fantasized about the broadness of his chest and the thickness of his neck…and about becoming his mistress once again.

And so their story goes. For a young woman interested in love without the hassle of a traditional relationship, an affair with someone else’s spoiled husband is just what she ordered—until it’s time to move on.

Then there’s Yuko: with even less time for married men’s shenanigans, she turns her attention to her aging father and the guilt of adultery that has gnawed at his heart for years. Her mother is long dead, yet her memory is enshrined for eternity in their—both father’s and daughter’s—mirrored indiscretions.

(Source: Drawn and Quarterly)

Note: Includes four parts of "Second Hand Love."

137336.description:
All Casia ever wanted was a happy home and a doll, but the former went out the window when the emperor forced her mother into marriage. Life as a princess was isolating but bearable... that is, until her mother was unjustly branded as a criminal. Now, with the help of her trusted aides, including the youngest prince, Casia is forging her own path outside the palace. As owner of her own doll shop, will she finally be able to escape the imperial family’s clutches and find her true happiness?

(Source: Tapas)

137338.description:
Miyuki has a crush on her boss, Kurama.
When she boldly confessed her feelings for him, Kurama told her that he has always liked her too......
But he asked her, "Are you sure about this? I have a sadistic fetish......"
As Miyuki became more and more devoted to Kurama, she accepted everything he had to offer as she's disciplined both physically and mentally.
It's an extreme and lewd love story between a dominant gentleman and an innocent maiden!

(Source: Opal Bunko, translated)

137340.description:
"Work is so hard... I just want to be at peace..."
When a corporate slave on the verge of breaking down encounters a beautiful girl searching for blood...
Is this what I was waiting for... A blissful death?
"What? You want to be killed? I just want some blood."
"Eeeehhhh, you must be kidding me!"
Today, tomorrow, and the future ahead, I want to live because I want to be killed by you!
A fateful, life-or-death romantic comedy!

(Source: Flex Comix, translated)

137342.description:
Just one day without sweets will cause my heart to become weaker to the point of nearly stop beating; until I met someone who could help my vitality last stronger and longer ーa patissier named Xia Shi! But after his girlfriend's death, he wouldn't make desserts anymore and opened a café instead, selling the bitterest coffee ever. So, to save my own life, I'll have to make him return to making desserts again! Please, oh please...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

137345.description:

With Leader at its helm, the musical group “Karriot” is brought to life by Gaia’s organ, Freya’s guitar, Seiichiro’s mandolin, and Nathaniel’s pipe… but his pipe isn’t just any ordinary pipe! Somehow, a virtual reality dating sim has invaded his real life, and now he has three men vying for his attention—and his body. Gowoon would prefer none of them, thank you very much, but the game won’t stop…unless, perhaps, he were to clear it. Maybe the only way out is through. And there’s only one way to find out…

(Source: Lezhin)

When country bumpkin Kang Bong-Soo lands a new office job in the big city, he falls in love at first sight with Yoo Ji-Won, the refined and sophisticated deputy manager in a neighboring department. After initially resigning to silently pine for Ji-Won, Bong-Soo unwittingly spots him making out with a man at a gay club and decides to confess his true feelings. When Bong-Soo’s plans to form an emotional connection go awry as Ji-Won responds with a naughty proposition, the innocent and naïve Bongsoo is caught completely off guard. How will Bong-Soo handle the sudden onset of sexy workplace flirting?

(Source: Lezhin US)

As someone with an over 10-year history of being a bottom, Toru is surprised by his top tendencies that only seem to come out when… he’s with his best friend?! Will this friendship stay a friendship for much longer? “Sweet Home” and “Busy Summer Nights”: When his classmates ask who he lives with, they always walk away, assuming Rio and his partner are just friends. Frustrated, Rio calls Etsu out for a night out together…

Daimon senses a hint of affection in Kojima's tyrannical attitude, and becomes more aware of him. However, when Kojima reveals with a laugh that it was all a scheme to humiliate Daimon, something inside Daimon snaps...!?

Despite this, his looks not only make it impossible for him to get a date, but also cause him to stand out from his fellow villagers and even his family. He's long known that he's different from everyone else, but it's only after he helps a girl recover her lost crystal ball that he gets a peek into his past and learns his feelings are true. To get the whole picture of his past, he'll need to set out on a life-changing journey, where foes and danger await. Join in this legendary time-spanning adventure crafted by storied manga creator Atsuji Yamamoto.

A spinoff of Shinji Wada's Sukeban Deka manga, Sukeban Deka Pretend centers on Asami, a cheerful girl who attends Takanoha High School. The story begins when she encounters a mysterious yo-yo, and a mysterious girl.

After the 16th play-through, Qianqiu finally realized that the world she was living in was just a game. However, she was not the heroine, but just the female support character, destined to always be the loser. Tired of being stuck in an endless loop, she decided to break free from the game's plot. However, in the process of doing so, the protagonist also started to act strangely?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

137592.description:
Jin-U is a struggling student who has to work several jobs. One day, he meets his best friend, Chan-Yeong and his girlfriend, Se-Jeong. Jin-U falls for Se-Jeong and breaks up with his girlfriend Yeo-Jin to be with her. However, Se-Jeong was not who she claimed to be...

(Source: TOPTOON+, edited)

137594.description:
The romance between the heroine who must die to go back and the hero who returns to stop her death Hero Arcane and Dana who is fated to die for heroine Stella. She must most faithfully live and die in order to go back to her own reality. But, why would the hero be so obsessed with me?! Also, is it just me or is it actually going way off the track...?! "I will never let you die because of me again, Dana!"

(Source: Lezhin)

137595.description:
Diablo Volpir, a powerful dark mage, was defeated and sealed away in a battle against the 12 gods. He finally wakes up from his sleep 66,666 years later, however, in the body of a newborn baby, Jamie Welton! 9 years later, with a fraction of power he once held and with the loving family and peaceful environment he is now surrounded by, Jamie plans to exact revenge against the 12 gods that had sealed him away.

Despite possessing beauty that could guarantee her an easy life, Elizabeth was forced to forge her own path from a young age, living alone in the Forbidden Forest and selling strawberries to get by. But everything changes one day when a handsome duke appears before her. Although he is taken with Elizabeth, she isn’t exactly seen as marriage material by those in the Duke’s circle. Persistent, he invites her to work at his uncle’s mansion as a maid. It’s purely professional, what could go wrong!

The story takes place in Japan, in a world where murderers are imprisoned in a closed space and executed in the same manner as the victims, and the execution is broadcast live.
The newly sentenced death row inmate, Kaoru Oda, is a murderer who strangled his lover to death in a love affair.
Kohei Mizutani, a prison guard, is selected and ordered to carry out Oda's execution simply because of their similar physique.

137600.description:
After Yuuka's suicide, her brother Asaharu is desperate for answers... and his guardian angel want's to help. This divine intervention may be closer to a deal with the Devil, though… "You have to kill Yuuka's killer" she says. "If you do that, I'll bring her back to life." Is he willing to bet his own life for a chance to save his sister? He may not like the answer that awaits him at the end of this twisted game!

(Source: Alien Books)

137601.description:
Orphaned at the age of seven, I was naïve to think my uncle took me in out of love. He promised to return the House of Edenbarre to me once I was of age, but he kept my father’s title and wealth. Not to mention my sweet cousin poisoned me after I learned of my uncle’s plans against the emperor. But with a second chance at life, I vow to take it all from them, as they did to me! Some may call me a villainess, but I’ll gladly use the tyrant emperor for my selfish interests. I’ll have my vengeance... as long as these suitors don’t get in my way!

(Source: Tapas)

137603.description:
Lee Si-Yeon and Lee Si-Eon are fraternal twins and lifelong enemies. Constantly at each other’s throats since a young age, these two have competed over everything with older twin sister, Si-Yeon, usually coming out on top. From stealing his toys to stealing his girlfriends, Si-Yeon has always taken everything her little brother, Si-Eon, called his own. That must have been what motivated him to try to and steal her object of interest, Seo Tae-Hyeon. Determined to turn the tables on his sister, Si-Eon bets Si-Yeon that he can get their classmate, Tae-Hyeon, to ask him out before she can. And so, the war for Tae-Hyeon’s love began. While gender preference would usually be a deciding factor, Tae-Hyeon has a traumatic secret that levels the playing field for the twins. Unless he can get over his painful past, it’s truly anyone’s game and the loser will have to quit school, leave home, and never show their face in front of the winner again. But, with everyone toying with each other’s emotions and prying deeper into their private lives, will anyone really come out a winner?

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

137604.description:
Queen Muse, a tech wiz with no experience in love, developed a game to learn about dating skills – by using real-life data to create virtual characters for players to seduce. Who knew that Muse's favorite idol Tang Jingting, turns out to be a masochist in-game! What’s even more shocking is that the real-life Tang Jingting actually found Muse, opened his mouth, and called her “master.” He even admitted that he was the character that she was trying to seduce in the game!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Nan Shen De Te Bie Ai Hao

137605.description:
Hibari is a manga editor who can't get excited by sex. When she was a college student, she fainted during her first sexual experience with her senpai Yanagi from their track and field club. Years later, Hibari reunites with Yanagi, who is the young master at the ryokan she is visiting on a work trip...

(Source: Digital Margaret, translated)

title.native: たっぷりのキスからはじめて

137606.description:
Dinner with friends takes a turn when Yeon-Ji’s coldhearted college ex shows up. After all those years, Hwa-Jo wants to try again… and to date like they used to. Should Yeon-Ji give it a second chance, when all Hwa-Jo did was leave her broken and humiliated? And why is Hwa-Jo reaching out now, just as their old college friend, Mo-Ju, has returned from abroad? The timing’s peculiar, but something’s different about Hwa-Jo. Will the two rekindle a broken love? Or will dark secrets of the past stand in their way?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Note: The prologue included in the English version in Tapas is exclusive of that version and will not be taken into account for the total chapter count once the series is over.

137607.description:
Yuzuru loved Ai in middle school, but they drifted apart. When they reunite, he realizes that his feelings haven’t changed. As this pair of total opposites gets reacquainted, will they end up as friends... or something more?

(Source: Yen Press)

137608.description:
A story that begins when the main character, Isshin Mamoru, finds a woman being attacked by a molester. Mamoru ends up getting beaten up by the molester and is saved by the woman, who reveals that she is the owner of an MMA gym.

Mamoru, who wants the power to protect others, applies for self-defense lessons and sways between the pain of learning martial arts and the joy of being in close contact with a beautiful trainer.

title.native: オトしてください！女神様!!

137609.description:
Luka is your picture perfect vampire―he’s good looking, he’s regal... He’s also usually incredibly hungover and exhausted, and wants nothing more than a change of pace from his routine! When he takes a peek into the human world, he finds just the cure he’s looking for―a relaxing bathhouse that will surely cure him of his hangover and rejuvenate him from head to toe. To blow his fatigue out of the water, Luka pays a visit to Mangetsu no Yu bathhouse where he meets the bathhouse’s eldest son, Sakura. But between the bathhouse being short staffed and taking care of his little brother, Sakura has enough to worry about without a bougie vampire being added to the mix!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

137610.description:
"Please marry me, for one-billion yen."

Koharu is a high school girl who likes to cook and help out at her family's restaurant. But Koharu's peaceful life is interrupted by the sudden proposal from Kurosaki, a mysterious regular customer whose face is obscured by his shaggy hair. He is polite and courteous, but his behavior is not quite normal. He just wouldn't take no for an answer. Will his pure-hearted and determined courtship lead to ― a happy marriage!?

(Source: Comic Polaris, translated)

137614.description:
Umiko, a grandma, realizes that she has the same desire to make movies as university student Kai—and soon she enrolls in Kai's film school!

"It's not the movies you like…you like watching the people watching the movies."

Just what are you going to do with the rest of your life? It's the question you'll always have to answer, no matter your age. Umiko Chino is a 65-year-old retired woman in mourning for her late husband. Remembering how they used to watch films together, Umiko goes to the movie theater for the first time in years, where she meets Kai, an attractive, ambiguous young man who studies filmmaking at a nearby art school.

They would seem to have nothing in common, except for this—both of them sometimes like to look more at the way the audience reacts to a movie than the movie itself. Kai believes Umiko has the same deep desire he possesses to experience how people respond to something they made… and challenges her to stake the rest of her life discovering that thrill.

Soon Umiko surprises herself by enrolling in the same film school as Kai. But sailing into this new sea, she's suddenly inside the currents of her fellow students' lives, a much younger generation that she struggles to understand, driven by their own passions and their own relationships. Who's really experienced at life, and is it old age or observation that brings wisdom? And does what you're looking for change when you look with your eyes instead of through a camera lens…?

(Source: Dark Horse)

title.english: The Credits Roll into the Sea
title.native: 海が走るエンドロール

137615.description:
The usual school, the usual classroom, the usual classmates...but something seems a bit off... When a boy realizes the source of his anxiety, he finally puts it to words. "I'm scared to die." The moment he opened his mouth and the sounds escaped his throat, a blood-filled hell has been unleashed as it slowly seeps out...

(Source: K-Manga)

137617.description:
Playful prankster Hashibami Yoake was born with a natural talent for mischief. One night, he discovers that his naughty antics can awaken the “Queen’s Blood” in one of four alluring elf sisters. To ensure all the girls have a fair shot, their guardian grants Yoake permission to prank them every night. What wild and sexy shenanigans will ensue? All of them!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

A 50s x 60s BL. We met when we were 18 and 28, from that time... until now, I've always loved you.

"I'll wait no matter how long, even 10 years or 20 years. Even when we've become old men."

Following the life path of two people from different generations—this is a tender life story. Akihiko, an employee in his 50s and Makoto, who's 10 years older than him, are lovers, sons and family. From when we meet as tutor and pupil, things that have changed, and things that are unchanged...

137619.description: Unlucky man Kiryuu was at a loss. He went to jail in place of his aniki, and when he was back, the group was long gone. Since then, he got entangled with weird people, his electricity was cut off, and finally he ran over a man. Mita, the accident's victim, is a handyman. Kiryuu decided to take care of Mita to apologize for injuring him. However, after a while, disturbing signs began to surround Mita...?

137620.description: A new one-shot to celebrate Bleach's 20th anniversary.

137622.description: Manga adaptation of the Italian movie "I cinque della vendetta" (Five Giants from Texas).

137623.description:
Tsukushi has always admired her best friend Hinoka and cherishes their friendship over everything. But one night, she wakes from a startling dream—one where Hinoka rejects her romantically! Except, Tsukushi hadn’t ever thought of confessing feelings to Hinoka before, but this strange dream gets her thinking. Does she have feelings for Hinoka? Was the dream some kind of foreshadowing? What would Hinoka think if she knew? As Tsukushi becomes determined to figure things out, her hyperfocus actually causes her to miss signs of Hinoka’s own feelings! Will the stars align for these girls to become girlfriends? Or will they miss their chance at the perfect romance?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

One is a blunt and proud superstar; another is a timid and persistent support-role. When will they finally admit their true feelings for each other?

In this world, there are many special, unique, and glamorous people. However, there are those who play a supporting role in these relationship dynamics. Lin Mu was one such character, where he played the role of a wallflower.

137628.description:
Ophelia's destined to be the antagonist of the story, persecuted for her wicked ways and lack of magical powers… until she gets a second chance. Aware of her fate, she makes amends for her notorious reputation and gathers allies, including the heroine, who's also her half-sister. How will her destiny change once these former rivals become best friends and she saves the lives of her father and steadfast bodyguard? If a visit from a strange spirit is an indicator, things are no longer by the book!

(Source: Tapas)

Note: This is a new, rebooted version of a previously cancelled manhua.

137629.description:
One cold winter night, after losing yet another job, young Tama finds herself back on the streets of the Imperial capital. But this time, fate intervenes when she meets Ginichi, a man with striking hair and the proprietor of Job Broker Ginko. He offers a place as his live-in shop assistant. Due to circumstances in her past caused by her strange ability, she's unable to express her feelings well. But, as she spends her days with the "spirited" neighbors at Ginko, she begins to change, little by little.

(Source: Manga UP!, edited)

137941.description:
At the age of two, Van, the fourth son of a marquis, recovered the memories of a previous life. He was becoming a child prodigy, but at the age of 8, he was found to have "production magic". In a world where offensive magic was considered superior, it was a "useless" aptitude.

His disappointed father thought that Van was not fit to be a nobleman, and Van was banished to become the lord of a nameless remote village with only his personal maid, Till. It was a desolate village with a population of only a hundred people and no local specialties, and it was on the verge of extinction. Van, seeing the situation, decided live a quiet life and develop the village with his knowledge from his previous life and his production magic, even though it was considered "useless." He not only equipped adventurers and built houses, but he also built a huge castle and even deployed ballistas for defense! The nameless frontier village was soon transformed into a huge city! A fantasy adventure of an exiled young reincarnated nobleman running a carefree domain is about to begin!

When his teacher asks him to check on Toomi, a classmate who's stopped coming to school, that chance meeting leads to an unexpected connection that neither young man expects. Toomi sees right through his diligent facade, and Nijou can't forget the cool comfort of Toomi's undemanding touch.

Hyeon-U struggles to make ends meet with a string of part-time jobs, but his best friend has a better idea. He urges Hyeon-U to conquer the Arena once again and earn a cushy living as a gaming celebrity. Vowing to strike it rich and avenge his father, the former Meleegod returns to the Arena as a newbie. He is expelled to the Forest Without Return, where he has a fateful encounter with a dying vampire girl. He who sacrificed himself and dedicated his blood to a girl - transformed into a vampire and rejuvenated into a boy! He who regained infinite magical power and acquired the special abilities of the vampire was named "Zero," and vowed revenge on Gilbald along with the vampire girl.

"It's bad, it doesn't matter a hundred before infinity" - the heroes who once gathered for the great war​ forced to run up from "Zero" this time!
